scope: FUNG governed product, AI system, Live Meeting, and Phase 4 Google Drive truth-sync audit

scaffold_validation.mermaid_fence_check: 20 Mermaid documents have balanced fences; renderer not installed
scaffold_validation.phase4_drive_traceability: 12/12 code, Edge, and migration nodes linked to authoritative docs; 4/4 focused test nodes linked
scaffold_validation.recording2_artifact_boundary: .tmp-transcript paths are local-only plain provenance, not repository links

findings.title: Recommended repository documentation is absent
findings.details: Scoped required artifacts exist. Root README.md, docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/api/README.md, and .editorconfig are absent.
findings.action: Add the recommended repository documents when their ownership and scope are approved.

findings.title: Historical and support-document control metadata is incomplete
findings.details: 62 of 247 Markdown documents lack one or more version, date, or status controls. Most are historical task briefs, support notes, or legacy plans; the five truth-synced authoritative documents have current controls and changelogs.
findings.action: Normalize authoritative documents first; preserve historical provenance rather than rewriting it.

findings.title: Traceability is mixed; annotations are intent-only
findings.details: 57 FR/NFR/BR/AC IDs are present across the expanded documentation corpus. The H3 contract retains all 26 scoped Live Meeting FR/NFR IDs and npm run test:traceability passes 1/1. The Phase 4 extension adds 12 linked code, Edge, and migration nodes plus four focused test nodes. Annotations and graph edges establish source/test intent only and do not close runtime, provider, staging, device, release, or UAT gates.
findings.action: Keep the all-26 annotation contract separate from retained manual/inspection mappings; do not promote runtime or UAT status from annotations.

findings.title: Executable annotations are intent, not release evidence
findings.details: The approved H3 contract resolves all 68 required @req annotations across its eleven exact target files and rejects unknown IDs; the focused contract passes 1/1. It covers all 26 scoped IDs for source/test intent but does not certify runtime, device, visual/keyboard, real-connector, or UAT behavior.
findings.action: Retain the focused annotation contract and add further IDs only through a separately approved scope; do not promote feature or release status from annotation evidence.

findings.title: Mermaid renderer validation is not available
findings.details: 20 Mermaid-containing documents have balanced fences; no renderer parser was installed or run.
findings.action: Add a Mermaid renderer check when diagram changes require syntax assurance.

findings.title: No central controlled-retrieval glossary exists
findings.details: MCP grant, connector, egress, evidence span, and sanitized result lack a central glossary.
findings.action: Add a compact glossary only when its product-document owner is approved.

truth_sync_results.evidence: Google Drive native authorization and enrollment nonce documents now record approved local implementation while retaining separate external and production gates.
Document graph now includes Phase 4 Google Drive, Native Session Broker, Edge, migration, and focused test nodes with 0 missing endpoints and 0 hash mismatches.
Recording2 transcript and minutes paths are labelled local-only provenance and are no longer represented as portable repository links.
Current local tests pass, but W1 executable PostgreSQL verification is skipped without Docker Desktop and all external/provider/device/production gates remain open.

reconciled_findings.evidence: FR-101 and FR-106--FR-114/FR-116 now reflect current default-off source evidence and preserve UAT boundaries.
Current graph derives 22/26 code and 16/26 test mappings from retained edges.
Design identifies external_connector_register as the sole transient credential exception and keeps production credential resolution/use open.
Implementation plan retains the preflight as a CRITICAL control; this post-fix audit supersedes the contradiction result without closing release or feature-flag gates.
Both entry points open LiveMeetingPanel; current desktop-bootstrap regression passes 5/5.

The approved exact source/test annotation contract is GREEN (68 required and observed annotations across eleven files, all 26 scoped FR/NFR IDs). This resolves the former zero-annotation H3 finding for source/test intent; runtime and UAT gates remain open.

reasons: No current critical documentation contradiction remains.
H3 scoped executable traceability is GREEN; broader requirement coverage remains mixed and evidence-bounded.
Phase 4 Google Drive and Native Session Broker local evidence is graph-linked and truth-synced; W1 executable PostgreSQL verification is environment-bounded on this host.
Real-provider, Supabase/Edge/RLS staging, clean Windows keyring, clean-install restore, device, signing/release, monitoring, and production gates remain open.
implementation_plan_gate.code_gate: Do not promote feature flags, release status, or external-runtime readiness from this documentation audit.
